description: Hook points of the generic kernel framework (the hooks table of kernel.json): before_verdict, after_verdict, before_reply.

before_verdict.when: a new request letter is about to be judged by the built-in rules (letters already in the queue do not pass here again)
before_verdict.if_blocked: the letter is refused (HookRejected, or BudgetMissing when the hook's stdout says so); the built-in rules and after_verdict do not run

after_verdict.when: the station judged a new letter, or a queued letter leaves the queue; fired hook by hook

fields.verdict: the verdict so far: pass, refuse or queue from the rules (an earlier hook may have changed it, also to hold)
fields.decision: stations that can hold only: pass when someone already said so, else null
fields.next: stations that forward only: null (the hook may give the next mailbox)

after_verdict.subject: verdict
after_verdict.if_blocked: the letter is refused (HookRejected, or BudgetMissing when the hook's stdout says so)

before_reply.when: a reply passes this station on its way back (only with reply_via_me)
before_reply.if_blocked: the reply is not applied: {"applied": false, "error": {"code": "HookRejected", ...}} goes back instead
